name: Even-Cycle Coefficient-Sphere Family
definition: Apply the oriented bipartite-graph construction $C(G)$ to a consistently directed cycle of even length $m\ge4$, alternating the two bipartition corners.
properties: The class has $m+3$ coordinates, $8m+8$ concepts, VC dimension three, coefficient dimension $d_m=8m+\binom m2$, and coefficient space $S^{m-2}\times\mathbb R^{d_m-m+2}$. It is convex-realizable, dismantlable ample, and finite convex-treelike. Its integral homology is that of $S^{m-2}$.
